messages:
Anna: Heads-up — spotted confusing error shapes in Python sample during onboarding. 401 shows as generic ApiError, 429 not parsing retry headers, messages vague. Any plan for typed exceptions + retry metadata?
Mike: Same in Node. Exception hierarchy isn't aligned across SDKs.
Jessica: Paste raw error?
Anna: `ApiError: request failed (status=401)` — no error.code or typed class. 429 body has 'RateLimited' but SDK throws ApiError.
Oleg: We should canonicalize: AuthError (401/403), RateLimitError(429) with retry_after, ClientError (other 4xx), ServerError (5xx). Base RedwoodError with httpStatus and raw.
Sara: Include retry fields: retry_after_ms, retryable=true, and maybe retry_idempotent_ok flag.
Mike: Also an automatic token-refresh hook for 401 flows.
Jessica: Suggest adding stable string codes (e.g., auth_invalid_token, rate_limit_exceeded) in JSON and a `hint` like `refresh_token|backoff|contact_support`.
Anna: Update sample app readme to show catching specific exceptions with fallback to ApiError. Example snippet: `if (err instanceof RateLimitError) { showToast('Rate limit, retrying...') } else if (err instanceof AuthError) { redirectToLogin() }`.
Oleg: I'll spec mapping and code names. Mike take Node + sample, Jessica take Python tests for Retry-After parsing.
Sara: Docs: add migration guide "Handling SDK errors: typed exceptions & retry metadata" and include formatErrorForUser helper.
ci-bot: Reminder to link RFC when creating the mapping PR — https://redwood.internal/rfcs :robot_face:
Anna: ETA?
Jessica: Python PR with tests in 48h.
Mike: Node PR + sample updates in 72h.
Oleg: Spec by EOD.
Anna: Great, thanks all. :thumbsup:
